findings.claim: Wait, however long it takes, for everything submitted ... to finish; Wait for everything submitted to finish.
findings.evidence: Creator HairGpu::finish delegates GpuGroomer::finish. The latter discards device.poll(PollType::wait_indefinitely()) Result. SDK29 requests no explicit timeout but can return an error, and waits only the latest submission observed when polling begins. WebGPU polling is a no-op. Returning unit cannot certify completion.
findings.remedy: Document a best-effort native wait for the most recent submission at poll time, with no explicit timeout; state the current API discards polling errors and does not certify GPU completion. Do not promise browser completion. If callers require a completion verdict, request owner-agreed source-preserving fallible API work as a connected repair rather than silently changing this review scope.
findings.owner: Existing Creator HairGpu / canonical GpuGroomer finish owners; Root must obtain/record whole-function agreement before shared repair
findings.acceptance: Both owning comments agree with actual result handling and native/browser semantics. A completed retained error/progress migration and caller adaptation is required if behavior is intentionally strengthened. No new tests/cases/helpers/assertions.

confirmed_contracts: MeshStripRows admits at least two rows; count may be zero. MeshStripLayout checks complete vertex and corner population before arithmetic/index generation. Faces have two triangles per segment with admitted u32 indices. Topology admission does not certify native allocation or arbitrary attribute/index membership.

CardStripLayout consumes the canonical generic strip topology. CardLayout remains a generic indexed-triangle count contract; direct CardMesh admission checks partial triangles and index membership. Generic triangles acquire no generated-card count. Host generated build clamps segment policy before admitted topology and preserves authored geometric calculations.

Strip output stores four vec4 attributes per vertex and separate per-row lift scratch. Native minimum allocations permit logical empty topology. GpuGeometry read checks actual device, trims to layout vertex bytes via Buffer.prefix, then reads exact logical arrays; no physical dummy records leak into host geometry.

StripSource compares allocating groom/card/level device with HairGpu context before construction. Nonempty ribbon prefix uses canonical StrandLayout and typed count; source rows and bounded subdivision retain owning topology. One invocation builds one strip. Batch submit Result propagates before returning produced geometry, without implying GPU completion.

Creator PlacedHair keeps GpuLods/source/body state together; forms enumerate immutable actual collections. Card ordinal past range chooses coarsest existing cut, missing family/strand ordinal returnsNone. Empty geometry remains separate from missing family. Strand budget uses two-edge row vertex population; physical cards are not generic triangle counts.

Bevy preview constructs on its paired render Device/Queue and binds resident native buffers directly. Mesh position values are placeholders for vertex count/skinning, and NoFrustumCulling avoids false placeholder bounds. Export reads actual geometry and retains atlas color/coverage channel mapping. Device-handled preview paths do not establish synchronous native validation.

Current renderer/LOD context is byte-identical to Root8c600 and retains primary resident FramePopulation before stochastic/transition cuts, actual indexed CardTriangles, candidate publication after normal queue submission and explicit native-provider limits. This review did not receive or reauthorize rewriting that context.
